Exam.title: Exam
Exam.description: An uploaded and parsed IELTS Reading exam with passages, questions, and answer keys.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this exam.

title.description: Title of the IELTS Reading exam.

partCount.description: Number of reading passages in the exam.

keyCount.description: Total number of answer keys extracted.

examPayload.description: Structured map containing parts, questions, and answers.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the exam was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the exam was last updated.

Attempt.title: Attempt
Attempt.description: A user's test attempt including recorded answers, band score, time spent, and highlights/notes.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who completed the attempt.

examId.description: ID of the associated Exam document.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the exam.

bandScore.description: Calculated IELTS Reading band score (0.0 to 9.0).

userAnswers.description: Map of question ID to user answer.

notesRegistry.description: Map of highlight ID to highlight metadata and sticky note.

savedPassageHtml.description: Map of part ID to highlighted passage HTML.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was last updated.

/exams/{examId}.description: Stores parsed IELTS Reading exams owned by individual users.

/attempts/{attemptId}.description: Stores completed IELTS Reading test attempts, scores, and highlights.
